DLF14_A.copy: Hook: the grandfather's dental-lab notebook beside today's dirty denture.
DLF14_A.prompt: An old worn leather notebook open on a workbench with faded handwriting too small and blurred to read, beside it a modern full upper denture on a paper towel coated in whitish slimy film and yellow-brown buildup, old dental lab hand tools on the bench. Gross-out realism: shot extremely close with the harsh direct phone flash, wet glistening highlights, every disgusting detail sharp. It should make the viewer physically recoil, like an unedited photo someone posted to complain. Realistic, not cartoonish, no blood, no gore, no text, no logos, every box, bottle and package plain white or grey with no printing.
